title: Where will India be 5 to 10 years from now? EAM Jaishankar answers

Additionally, Jaishankar contrasted the significant influence held by the United States and China with that of current middle powers, recognizing the complexity of evolving global power dynamics.

title: Curtain comes down in Aichi-Nagoya as Doha receives flag for Asian Games 2030

India concluded the Games with 85 medals, including 21 gold, and finished fourth overall. China led the medal tally, securing its best performance outside its home territory. Despite organisational challenges, individual athletic performances celebrated the spirit of competition. As the Games transitioned to Doha, the focus shifted towards preparations for 2030.

Investigators are looking into a land dispute as a potential motive, and an FIR will be filed once the victim's family's statements are collected.
